# ELITE CLASSES — An Exclusive Mission For Futuristic Education

> Founded by Ravi Yadav in Sector 35, Noida, ELITE CLASSES is a subject-specialist rotational home tuition and global live HD EdTech ecosystem serving Noida, Greater Noida, Noida Extension, and worldwide online students.

## Website
- Official URL: https://eliteclassesnoida.in

## Core Programs
- **School Tuition (Grades 1–12):** CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE boards with dedicated Foundation Mentors (Grades 1–5) and Rotational STEM + Humanities Subject Specialists (Grades 6–12).
- **School Entrance Exams:** Sainik School (AISSEE), Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNVST), RIMC, and Olympiads.
- **Competitive & College Entrance:** IIT-JEE, NEET, and CUET.
- **Government & Higher Exams:** Banking (IBPS/SBI), SSC, and UGC NET.

## Key Differentiators
- **Rotational Subject-Specialist Pod:** Separate STEM (Maths & Science) and Humanities (English, SST, Hindi) specialists instead of a single generalist tutor.
- **Founder's Direct Monitoring:** Weekly syllabus audits and Saturday CBT test tracking overseen directly by Ravi Yadav.
- **24-Hour Backup Tutor Guarantee:** Instant verified replacement on leave or mismatch with zero syllabus loss.
- **Student & Parent Super-App:** Live HD classrooms, interactive whiteboard, 3D STEM labs, active-recall flashcards, PDF notes vault, homework & attendance logs, timed CBT mock exams (+4/-1), and printable branded PDF report cards & fee receipts.

## Serviceable Areas
- **Central Noida:** Sectors 15, 18, 22, 29, 34, 35 (HQ), 44, 50, 51, 52.
- **Noida Expressway:** Sectors 61, 62, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79, 104, 120, 137, 142, 150.
- **Greater Noida & Noida Extension:** Greater Noida West, J.M. Florence, Gaur City 1 & 2, Pari Chowk, Alpha/Beta/Gamma Sectors, Jaypee Greens, Knowledge Park.
- **Global Live Online:** Delhi NCR, Pan-India, USA, UK, UAE/Middle East, and Singapore.
